# Claude Desktop

This host keeps its config in your user profile.

## Install

```
headwaters install --host claude-desktop
```

The installer prints the diff first and writes only after a yes; `--dry-run` stops at the
diff and `--json` prints the same plan as a document.

## Files

| File | What the install does |
| --- | --- |
| `<appdata>/Claude/claude_desktop_config.json` | create |

## What you still do

- Restart Claude Desktop after the install: it reads <appdata>/Claude/claude_desktop_config.json only at start.
- Claude Desktop gets the Headwaters MCP tools; it has no command files or rules, so the model switch commands come from `headwaters_recommend_model` instead.

## Templates behind this page

The entries above are rendered from `claude_desktop` in `headwaters/installer/templates/`, so this page and a real install cannot drift.

## Check it

```
headwaters doctor --host claude-desktop
```

The doctor reads this host's own config back and reports a missing or stale entry; a
clean report means the host is talking to the gateway.

## Remove it

```
headwaters uninstall --host claude-desktop
```

The uninstall restores the backed-up file unless it was edited after the install; then it
asks for `--force`.
